message.content: Known failing scenario in hand — I'll shrink it to a minimal reproducing case and start triaging the energy loss.

Evidence points to integration error from large dt during the deep close approach. I'll test a smaller timestep to isolate the cause.
A smaller dt eliminates the energy drift — I have a valid counterfactual and will submit the final report.
